newsitem.title: USA: House of Fabrics restates Oct 31 $0.10/shr.
newsitem.headline: House of Fabrics restates Oct 31 $0.10/shr.

text.p: House of Fabrics Inc said Thursday it restated the quarter ended Oct 31, 1996, from the previously reported after-tax earnings of $874,000 to $520,000, or $0.17 per share to $0.10 per share, to reflect an additional provision for income taxes of $354,000.

As part of House of Fabrics's emergence from Chapter 11, the company was required to adopt fresh start accounting rules which require it to provide income taxes on earnings, notwithstanding the possible availability of pre-exit tax net operating losses.
